source.nature: flattened perspective-skewed concept collage, not source vector/Figma file

reference_calibration.corner_accuracy: approximately ±2–5 source pixels; after warp this varies by screen and is roughly ±3–9 rectified pixels / points
reference_calibration.interpretation: bbox_pt is an approximate measured visible component bounding box on the rectified 390×844 canvas; it is not original source Auto Layout constraint or source font metadata.

coordinate_convention.angle: clockwise positive degrees; estimated visual target, not source font glyph angle
coordinate_convention.text_angle: rotates the entire text wrapper, not individual glyphs
coordinate_convention.hit_target: keep unrotated semantic hit target >=44×44pt wherever feasible
